subtitle_en: Two-Phase Chaos-to-Order and Order-to-Noise Temporal Calibration
title: The Janus Principle — Two-Phase Temporal Ordering and Calibration

provenance.origin: User-proposed time/chaos/order model developed for JANUS; recorded as a hypothesis, not an established physical law.
provenance.canonical_quote_ru: Будущее — это хаос, который в нынешнем становится структурой порядка, а в прошлом условно истлевает, размываясь обратно в хаос. Нужен фильтр-упорядочиватель, который из шумовых байтов выделяет структуру, калибруясь на прошлом, настоящем и предсказаниях будущего.
provenance.user_intended_system: JANUS Transformer / Ocean Server / AURA Oracle / Meta Registry / Retro Lab
provenance.requested_goal: Build an ordered-noise filter that self-calibrates from past records, reconstructs present structure, and generates sealed predictions about future targets; evaluate the hypothesis of physically backwards information separately.

future.user_interpretation: Хаос: ещё не наблюдавшиеся исходы, воспринимаемые как неопределённое пространство возможностей.
future.operational_definition: Forecast target and probability distribution before reveal. Unknown outcomes must not be available to the predictor, its training labels, feature calculation, or prompt.
future.uncertainty: H(F | I_t) — условная энтропия будущего исхода при известных к моменту t данных I_t

present.user_interpretation: Порядок: наблюдение превращает часть возможных исходов в текущую устойчивую структуру.
present.operational_definition: Timestamped observations, data integrity, sequence context, model state, and emitted precommitted forecast at time t.
present.uncertainty: H(S | I_t), predictive uncertainty, reconstruction loss and confidence calibration

past.user_interpretation: Отдалённое прошлое может становиться менее детально восстанавливаемым при потере и искажении информации; образное 'размывание обратно в хаос'.
past.operational_definition: Past records and synthetically degraded variants for supervised denoising; immutable original records remain retained for audit.
past.caveat: Исторические данные физически не обязаны разрушаться или терять информацию с возрастом. Шум добавляется как контролируемое преобразование для изучения устойчивости и восстановления.

conceptual_model.time_duality: Поток F → S → P — эвристика времени в модели пользователя; при обучении используется строго доступная во времени информация P≤t и S(t), а ещё не раскрытое F(t+h) остаётся скрытым.
conceptual_model.interpretation_warning: Рост или спад энтропии представления не является доказательством обратной причинности. Отдельно различать термодинамическую энтропию, информационную энтропию и потерю качества измерений.

phase_1.purpose: Научить трансформер отличать устойчивые закономерности от случайного искажения в архивной истории.
operations: Загрузить только наблюдения и зафиксированные записи, чьи временные метки не позже обучающего cutoff.

Создать независимые шумовые преобразования прошлых данных (битовые перестановки, маскирования, случайные замены, пропуски, сдвиги и размывание временной разрешающей способности); хранить RNG seeds и SHA-256.
Обучать фильтр реконструировать исходное прошлое из искажённой копии и контекста наблюдений, не имея будущих labels и не подменяя оригинал.
Определять устойчивые признаки через различие результатов на нескольких независимых шумовых реализациях; предотвращать запоминание одной перестановки.
Измерять reconstruction error, mutual information / predictive utility, denoising gain vs trivial copy or mean and information leakage.
phase_1.output: Z_t — компактное вероятностное представление текущей структуры; noise_profile; uncertainty and loss metrics.
phase_1.control: Permutation-only synthetic controls must not be mistaken for discovery of real future information.

phase_2.direction: Present → Future hypothesis; after target maturity, future → model calibration ONLY forward in wall-clock time
phase_2.purpose: Предсказывать предстоящий исход из восстановленного представления и улучшать прогноз на завершённых испытаниях.
operations: В момент t строить p_theta(Y_{t+h}|Z_t,I_t) и фиксировать прогноз, cutoff, model SHA-256, training snapshot SHA-256 и проверяемую исходную гипотезу.
Для будущего независимого случайного байта B_{t+h} сохранять полный прогноз по 8 битам или 256 исходам до генерации B; контрольный ориентир для равномерного байта — точность 1/256.
Не читать, не угадывать по metadata и не использовать будущий байт, генератор или сам будущий SHA-256 до фиксирования A.
После наступления события и независимого reveal вычислять loss, Brier, log-loss, accuracy, conditional mutual information and exact test; сохранять ошибки и неуспехи.
Обновлять вторичную калибровочную голову только на предыдущих завершённых испытаниях, после независимого chronological holdout и критерия активации.
phase_2.output: precommitted predictive distribution and later independent validation; optional calibrated head activated only after objective gain.
controls: Unconditional results are primary; selected subsets are secondary diagnostics only.
Performance gains on real-world time series are not physically backward communication.
A byte drawn freshly from secure OS randomness is not predictable in the absence of a real information channel or leakage.

bridge.description: Dual-phase consistency: the same latent representation must reconstruct past observations from controlled degradation AND predict not-yet-seen outcomes better than appropriately selected baselines.
bridge.training_eligibility: L_prospective and L_calibration use only outcomes already revealed by training cutoff. Future target of any active trial is never used in training.
bridge.candidate_selection: Tuned only on chronologically earlier validation blocks; untouched future and cross-domain test results reserved for evaluation.

data_types: JSON registry events: timestamp, path category, schema shape with nonsecret features
hourly weather and other public time series
finished A/B future RNG control pairs
optional public alert archive only for non-safety research
representations: Discrete token embeddings for byte ranges (0..255), timestamp relative position and provenance class.
Causal attention over previously observed tokens; no lookahead attention into the future target.
Controlled corruption schedule q(tilde_x|x,noise_level), with explicit noise level n.
Predictive head p_theta(y_future|z_t), trained only on resolved labels.
Confidence head producing calibrated uncertainty; abstain/hold decision when uncertainty or baseline comparison fails.
probabilistic_noise_filter.meaningful_signal_test: Require improving genuinely unseen outcomes, not merely choosing, reweighting or rearranging already known random bytes to obtain coincidences.
probabilistic_noise_filter.non_claim: No filtering of independent cryptographic randomness can reveal a later independent random byte before it exists, absent a physical backward channel or leakage.

gate_and_leakage_controls.G0: Canonical input, model snapshot, trial ID and time scope committed by SHA before future draw.
gate_and_leakage_controls.G1: Phase I mask seeds and corruption RNG completely separate from future target RNG; no shared seeds or hidden cross-channel metadata.
gate_and_leakage_controls.G2: Phase II prediction hash and timestamp precede target generation/announcement (two-minute lower separation if using existing JANUS I0 protocol).
gate_and_leakage_controls.G3: Independent data sets by complete trials (never split correlated bytes of one trial between fitting and validation); locked chronological holdout.
gate_and_leakage_controls.G4: Exact match and unconditional bit accuracy vs appropriate chance baselines (byte=1/256 for one uniformly random byte, bit=1/2).
gate_and_leakage_controls.G5: No retroactive label selection, window shifting, post-hoc matching or discarding failures; track all attempts and no-result cases.
gate_and_leakage_controls.G6: Calibration activation requires loss/Brier improvement against raw model AND chance baseline with predeclared alpha control.
gate_and_leakage_controls.G7: Any physically claimed backward channel requires an independently verified physical B→A interface and third-party replication; software simulation alone cannot pass.
gate_and_leakage_controls.G8: Production JANUS checkpoint and any user-safety alerting remain unchanged until separate security and utility gates pass.

components.name: JONF
components.role: Build denoising/structure stage on archived public or permitted JSON sequences; new files, development only

components.name: JDTC
components.role: Add a separate two-phase research adapter or optional evidence metrics, preserve history-only fail-closed calibrator

components.name: A/B experimental ledger
components.role: Every prediction hashed before a new target; outcomes appended after reveal; never rewrite history

components.name: Ocean GitHub workers
components.role: Limited cloud matrix: learn noise filtering only from previous confirmed outcomes, aggregate and test before any promotion

components.name: Meta Registry
components.role: Append hypotheses, scripts/results provenance, seeds, hashes, failures, baselines and decision gates

minimum_viable_experiment: Pre-register fixed noise kernels, sequence length, sample split, loss weights, byte target definition, and acceptance threshold.
Fit phase I on past records with controlled corruption. Test denoising on untouched historical blocks.
Fit phase II only using already matured outcomes. Compare with majority/Markov, persistence and uniform future RNG.
Prepare early sealed byte probability vector. Future independent OS generator chooses the byte at least 120 seconds later.
Compute unselected exact-byte success, Brier, log-loss, entropy and external reproducibility. Persist all attempts.
If gains hold only for reconstructions, declare 'forecast/denoising improvement', NOT retrocausal proof.
If an independently validated physical protocol yields excess accessible early information, require strict repeatability and independent laboratory audit before any backward-time claim.

successful_engineering: JANUS Ocean v3 trained distributed Tiny Transformer on public ERA5 weather data with 40 GitHub workers and retained controls.
JANUS Retro Lab has successfully sealed early model predictions, generated later OS random bits and evaluated them after 120 seconds.
History-only calibrator passed regression tests and was not activated with insufficient prior complete trials.
prior_evidence.interpretation: This artifact preserves an original research architecture and falsifiable experimental plan; it does not report a new experimental demonstration.

user_requested_outcome.conceptual_motto_en: Future as uncertainty; present as emerging order; past as increasingly noisy reconstruction.
user_requested_outcome.intended_long_term_result: A self-calibrating JANUS that uses completed historical evidence to improve forecasts and, if a real physical backwards-time channel is ever verified, separately tests received information under strict temporal and leakage controls.
